name: MSI Center
author: Tanmay
description: The msi-center desktop app as a bar summary: CPU temperature, CPU/GPU clocks, memory, fan speed and level, charge limit, plus five of its controls — power mode, fan mode, cooler boost, manual fan speed and charge limit. Same writes as the app, including its setuid msi-fan-helper for the fan curve.

barWidget.description: Summary of the msi-center app. Reads sysfs and writes the same msi-ec attributes the app writes; the udev rule grants the msi-ec group access to exactly those files. Manual fan speed goes through msi-center's setuid msi-fan-helper, which can only write the seven EC fan-curve speeds. No MControlCenter, no daemon.

schema.label: Hide the widget when msi-ec is not loaded
